digest: Coverage centred on Mercedes' dominance, with Kimi Antonelli leading George Russell in a second practice interrupted by two red flags to sweep Friday's running (Autosport, BBC Sport). Analysis put Antonelli nearly a second clear of Max Verstappen on long runs, while Lando Norris called Mercedes "at a different level" (Motorsport.com). Verstappen described a "disconnect" at Red Bull, and Charles Leclerc linked his spin to a lack of grip (Motorsport.com). Tyre wear also featured, reaching 100% in 15 laps, beyond Pirelli's expectations (Autosport).
